svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.29.2.1 Where Required
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.29 INTERIOR WALL AND CEILING FINISHES
Waterproof finish is provided to a height of
(a) 1.8 m (5′-10⅞″) above the floor in shower
stalls, (b) 1.2 m (3′-11¼″) above the rims of
bathtubs equipped with showers, and (c) 400 mm
(15¾″) above the rims of bathtubs not equipped
B to D to one scale, finish drawn at the minimum heights. Stall and tub sizes are schematic.
